Subtract 286 days from 1772-05-21.  
1772 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not a century exception).  
From 1772-05-21 back 21 days → 1772-04-30.  
Remaining 286 − 21 = 265 days earlier.  
265 days earlier from 1772-04-30: go into 1771.  
From 1772-01-01 to 1772-04-30 is 31+29+31+30 = 121 days.  
265 − 121 = 144 days earlier into 1771.  
1771-12-31 minus 144 days: 1771-12-31 → minus 1 day → 1771-12-30, minus 31 days → 1771-11-29, minus 30 → 1771-10-30, minus 31 → 1771-09-29, minus 31 → 1771-08-29, remaining 144 − (1+31+30+31+31) = 144 − 124 = 20 days earlier.  
1771-08-29 minus 20 days = 1771-08-09.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1771-08-09
